title: Vesper and the Cover
author: Lena Winterbourne
blurb: Paloma Blackwood, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
